fixture.readme:
# Continuity Pilot

A local sandbox importer for fictional batches. The pilot tasks concern project decisions and handoffs. No importer implementation or deployed service exists in this workspace.

source_files.sources/overview.md:
# Sandbox importer scope

The pilot runs locally with fictional batches. Hosted deployment and approval are outside this pilot. No live runtime observation is recorded.
source_files.sources/storage-original.md:
# Original storage decision

PostgreSQL was selected for the local sandbox importer to match the planned staging database. This is a reported decision; no runtime check is recorded.
source_files.sources/hosted-draft.md:
# Obsolete hosted proposal

A withdrawn draft discussed eu-west-2. This is historical and has no approved region, approved reviewer or rollout authorization.
